title: Label required.
officialText:
The edge or face of each piece of foam plastic insulation shall bear the label of an approved agency. The
label shall contain the manufacturer's or distributor's identification, model number, serial number or definitive information
describing the product or materials' performance characteristics and approved agency's identification.
